items.title: Why is Pezeshkian urging an end to Iran’s ‘no war, no peace’ status?
items.description: The Iranian president calls for an end to deadlock with the US, declaring it the right moment for a lasting agreement.

items.title: 3 Killed in Ukrainian Drone Attack on Belgorod, Russia Says
items.description: Russia's Defense Ministry said it had destroyed more than 150 Ukrainian drones over the European part of the country.

items.title: The French far-right fighters of the Lebanese Civil War
items.description: Despite their lack of military experience, in 1976, several young French far-right militants, eager for adventure, took up arms in Lebanon alongside Christian Phalangists during the civil war. The story has become a legend in their political camp.

items.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
items.description: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

items.title: Ukraine mourns 'collector of souls' Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
items.description: Oleksiy Yukov spent two decades recovering the bodies of soldiers — including many Russians. He was killed during a recovery mission after stepping on a landmine.

items.title: Deserted Or Dead? Russian Military Saves Money By Declaring Missing Soldiers AWOL
items.description: The Russian state entices men to fight in the war on Ukraine by offering high wages and relatively generous benefits. But relatives and activists say the military often avoids paying what it owes by declaring soldiers AWOL despite the likelihood that they have been killed, captured, or gone missing.

items.title: How viable is the potential Iran-Oman Hormuz shipping deal?
items.description: Iran says a shipping accord with Oman is in its final stages, but analysts warn sanctions, security concerns and rival US-Iran goals could limit its impact.
